name: Mukhyamantri Work Form Home-Job Work Yojana
benefit:
> **Financial and non-financial incentives -**

1. Advertisement of such private unit which provides work from home-job work to a maximum number of women will be displayed free of cost on the Work from Home-Job Work portal.
1. If a private unit provides work from home - job work to women and the payment for the work given to the woman is more than ₹  5,000, then ₹  3,000 per trainee will be given
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The minimum age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. Preference will be given to widow/abandoned/divorced/disabled/victim of violence.
